description: 6 exemplars (one German) + 3 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Authored 2026-10-13 under road-to-skill-scripts-that-run-where-they-land, which rewrote this skill's grounded-corpus invocation to the bundled `node <skills-root>/…/ground.mjs` form and so brought it into check_routing_coverage's touched-skill scope. Exemplars are the one thing this skill owns — bringing a NEW endpoint into existence, stated either as a route to add or as a capability to expose — including the case where the stack is named, because naming the stack does not bypass this skill: detecting the stack and handing off to the carve-out IS its procedure. Near-misses are three neighbours that share endpoint vocabulary and answer a different question: the contract decision about an endpoint that already exists (api-design), restructuring a handler that already exists (code-refactoring), and testing one (api-testing). Counterexamples guard the word API itself — a key-issuance doc and a vendor-choice question both say API and ask for no handler.

queries.q: add a POST /api/invoices endpoint that creates an invoice from the request body
we need a REST route that returns a paginated list of projects for the mobile app
expose this service method over HTTP so the frontend can call it
build the webhook receiver Stripe will POST to, with signature verification
this is a Laravel app — add the endpoint that archives a user, following our conventions
queries.note: naming the stack does not skip this skill; the handoff to laravel-api-endpoint is its own step

queries.q: leg einen POST-Endpunkt an, der aus dem Request-Body eine Rechnung erzeugt
should the new field on /api/users be nested or flat, and does this need a v2?
queries.note: contract and versioning on an existing endpoint → api-design

queries.q: the /api/orders handler is 300 lines — split the business logic out of it
write integration tests for the /api/invoices endpoint, including the 422 path
document in the README how a customer requests an API key for our public API
which third-party API should we buy for address autocomplete?
